South Africa , officially the Republic of South Africa ( RSA ), is the southernmost country in Africa . [ d ] Its nine provinces are bounded to the south by 2,798 kilometres (1,739 miles) of coastline that stretches along the South Atlantic and Indian Ocean ; [ 16 ] [ 17 ] [ 18 ] to the north by the neighbouring countries of Namibia , Botswana , and Zimbabwe ; to the east and northeast by Mozambique and Eswatini ; and it encloses Lesotho . [ 19 ] Covering an area of 1,221,037 square kilometres (471,445 square miles), the country has a population of over 63 million people, making it the sixth-most populated country in Africa. Pretoria is the administrative capital , while Cape Town , as the seat of Parliament , is the legislative capital, and Bloemfontein is regarded as the judicial capital. [ 20 ] The largest and most populous city is Johannesburg , followed by Cape Town and Durban .
